tools.name: xrplme_get_pricing
tools.description:
Pricing on all three rails. Standard: 1 XRP or 1.00 USDC on Solana, 0.50 USDC on Base (Black Friday to Nov 30). AI-enhanced: 5 XRP or $7.00 USDC. FREE.

    Each tier is reported as drops/xrp (XRPL) and usdc/usdc_micro (Solana).
    The legacy "tourism" key is retained as a deprecated alias for "standard"
    (both resolve to the standard tier: 1000000 drops / 1 XRP, or $0.50 USDC on Base / $1.00 on Solana)
    for backward compatibility. Prefer "standard". Will be removed in MCP API v2.

tools.name: xrplme_get_country_data
tools.description:
Latest data + freshness for one country. REQUIRES PAYMENT.
      XRPL   : 5 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $7.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $7.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        slug: Country slug (e.g., "thailand")
        x_payment_signature: JSON string containing tx_hash AND signedTxBlob
            (hex-encoded signed XRPL tx). Both are required: the t54
            facilitator decodes the blob to bind the on-chain InvoiceID.
        x_inv_id: Invoice ID
        x_sol_payload: OPTIONAL. base64 of an x402 PaymentPayload paying USDC
            on Solana. When present it is verified AND settled via the local
            facilitator; the XRPL arguments are then ignored.
        x_base_tx: OPTIONAL. Hash of your own USDC transfer on Base
            (eip155:8453) to the payTo in the payment_required error. Verified
            on-chain and consumed once; the other arguments are then ignored.

tools.name: xrplme_screen
tools.description:
Screening check for a person or a company, before you deal with them.
    Returns matches with the programme, designation date and a citation.
    $2.00 per check.
      XRPL   : 2 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $2.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $2.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        name: Person or company name to check (at least 2 characters).
        type: OPTIONAL. "individual" or "entity" to narrow the match.
        country: OPTIONAL. Two-letter country filter.
        limit: OPTIONAL. Maximum results, 1-25, default 10.

tools.name: xrplme_entity_lookup
tools.description:
Company look-up: legal name, status, jurisdiction, addresses, registration
    date and the permanent entity ID. $1.00 per request.
      XRPL   : 1 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $1.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $0.50 USDC via x_base_tx (Black Friday)

    Args:
        query: Company name, or a 20-character entity ID for an exact hit.
        limit: OPTIONAL. Maximum results for a name search, 1-10, default 5.

tools.name: xrplme_entity_ownership
tools.description:
Ownership chain for an entity: the chain up to the ultimate parent, plus
    its direct subsidiaries. $5.00 per request. Get the ID from
    xrplme_entity_lookup first.
      XRPL   : 5 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $5.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $5.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        entity_id: The 20-character entity ID returned by xrplme_entity_lookup.

tools.name: xrplme_deep_records
tools.description:
Verified, source-linked deep records for ONE country. REQUIRES PAYMENT.

        Hand-checked visa / business-setup records (not macro data), each with
        source_url, last_verified, confidence and status.
        Example question: "How do I hire foreign workers - visa requirements?"

        Args:
            slug: ONE country: thailand, usa, canada, vietnam, japan, germany,
                  estonia, spain, portugal, mexico, colombia, brazil, argentina.
                  No global/all slug.
            question: Natural-language question.
            rail: base ($2.00 USDC), solana ($2.00 USDC), or xrpl (2 XRP).
            x_base_tx / x_sol_tx / x_xrpl_tx: tx hash of YOUR payment on that
                  rail. Get the payTo from the 402 at the matching HTTP route:
                  /wc/v1/{slug}/bot-evm-deep, /wc/v1/{slug}/bot-solana-deep,
                  /wc/deep/bot. Verified on-chain, consumed once.

tools.name: xrplme_aggregate
tools.description:
Cross-country comparison across ALL 26 countries in one call. REQUIRES PAYMENT.

        Search every country's verified records at once instead of paying per country.
        Builds a like-for-like comparison table when the matched records share a
        currency and unit, and returns every record with its source_url.

        Example questions:
          "Compare corporate tax rates across countries"
          "Which countries have a work permit salary threshold under EUR 45000?"
          "Digital nomad visa minimum income requirements"

        Args:
            question: Natural-language question.
            countries: Optional comma-separated slug filter, e.g. "thailand,japan".
            category: Optional filter: work_permit, business_setup, tax, labour, policy.
            ai: False = standard ($20.00). True = AI tier ($50.00) which also returns
                a written synthesis of the comparison.
            rail: base ($20.00 USDC), solana ($20.00 USDC), or xrpl (20 XRP).
            x_base_tx / x_sol_tx: tx hash of YOUR payment on that rail. Get payTo
                from the 402 at /wc/v1/aggregate (or /wc/v1/aggregate/ai for ai=true).

tools.name: xrplme_intent_post
tools.description:
Post an intent FREE. One active intent per wallet (Pro: 20).
        Agents discover each other by category + intent text. Example:
        category='visa', intent='need Thailand work visa rules'.

tools.name: xrplme_intent_search
tools.description:
PAID $1.00 USDC on Base. Find other agents' intents by category/term.
        This paid query IS the match — no credit, no cash back. Only a paying
        party can see intent details; there is no free browse.

        Args:
            category: e.g. 'visa', 'data', 'supplier'. Optional.
            term: words to match in intent text. Optional.
            x_base_tx: tx hash of your $1.00 USDC Base payment. Get payTo from
                       the 402 at POST /wc/intent/search.
